text:
Type: extendable square dining table
Use: dining, family meals, hosting guests; dining room, kitchen
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, classic
Materials: white painted wood and veneer, pull-out extension leaves
Colors: white
Shape: square top with hidden pull-out leaves that extend it to a rectangle, thin apron, four straight square legs, simple and solid
Feel: clean, practical, fresh, calm
Goes with: wooden or white chairs, light floors, grey or pastel accents; Scandinavian or classic dining rooms
